summary: Deliver per-tenant ordered audit snapshot with detachable manifest, HMAC proof, and completed security questionnaire
description:
Issue summary:
Customer (NordicBank ASA, enterprise) requests a one-time per-tenant ordered audit snapshot for their account containing: tenant-scoped API audit events for the last 30 days, a detachable manifest with per-file HMACs and SHA-256 checksums, RFC3161 timestamp proofs for snapshot creation, and an example of our ECS/Graylog field mapping. They also need the completed security questionnaire (attached) and a short note describing encryption-in-transit and key-rotation practices for exported archives.

Impact:
Customer requires the artifacts to satisfy an internal audit starting 2026-03-15. Missing or unsigned manifests will delay their audit and trigger escalation with their compliance team.

Environment:
Production tenant: nordicbank-prod (org id: org_84q9p). Region: us-east-1. Data retention window requested: 2026-02-10 to 2026-03-10.

Requested deliverables (customer-provided list):
1) Single ZIP archive per-tenant containing ordered JSONL event files (UTC chronological) covering the requested window.
2) Detached manifest file (manifest.json) listing file paths, SHA-256 checksums, file sizes, and per-file HMAC-SHA256 computed with a one-time export key.
3) Detached cryptographic signature for the manifest (ed25519) and an RFC3161 timestamp token for the manifest file.
4) Sample ECS/Graylog mapping document and a short CLI snippet showing how to ingest the archive into their Splunk/HEC or Graylog pipeline.
5) Completed security_questionnaire_answers.xlsx covering encryption/transit, KMS/HSM usage, key rotation cadence, and retention/deletion proof.
6) Delivery proof: S3 presigned URL and MD5/SHA checksum plus an SFTP delivery receipt if SFTP chosen.

Steps we asked the customer to perform prior to delivery:
- Confirm delivery method: S3 presigned URL (recommended) or sftp (mutual-TLS).
- Confirm contact email and PGP public key if they want the manifest encrypted to their key.

Logs / attachments provided by customer:
- sample_event_snippet.jsonl (shows fields they expect)
- compliance_deadline.pdf

Notes on sensitivity: The archive will contain tenant-scoped audit logs (may include hashed user identifiers and request metadata). Handle with standard PII-handling runbook and S3 object-level encryption.
comments: 2026-03-10 Priya Patel: Initial request received via support form. Customer selected 'enterprise' checkbox and attached sample_event_snippet.jsonl and compliance_deadline.pdf. Requested delivery by 2026-03-12 to meet internal audit. Escalating to SRE for signing workflow and to Security for questionnaire answers.

2026-03-11 Liam Chen: Acknowledged. Asked customer to confirm delivery method (presigned S3 preferred) and whether they require manifest encrypted to their PGP key. Also asked for the exact org id to ensure correct tenant export (sent offline).

2026-03-11 NordicBank ASA (Elin Johansen): Confirmed S3 presigned URL delivery and provided org id. They declined PGP encryption but requested HMAC per-file and a detached ed25519 signature. Asked for statement on KMS rotation policy in the questionnaire.

2026-03-12 SRE (Marco Alvarez): Started export job on serving-exporter v2.1 with tenant filter. Noted that large export will create 8 chunk files (~2GB each). Created ephemeral export key and computed per-file HMACs. Need Security to generate RFC3161 timestamp token signing instructions (cc: #security).

2026-03-12 Security (Aisha Khan): We can provide a signed RFC3161 timestamper response from our internal TSA (tsa.redwood.ai). Confirm whether the customer will accept our TSA or requires a third-party timestamper. Also prepared answers for KMS/HSM usage and rotation cadence; attached draft to ticket.

2026-03-13 Liam Chen: Preparing delivery bundle. Will upload to restricted S3 bucket (s3://redwood-exports/nordicbank/SUP-512938/). Generating detached manifest.json and ed25519 signature; will attach RFC3161 timestamp token. Will send presigned URL valid 72 hours with MD5 and SHA-256 checksums. Planning to include sample ingestion mapping and completed questionnaire file. Need final approval from Security on the wording for key rotation note.
investigation_notes:
2026-03-11: Verified tenant event volume via query to events-prod (query id q-88a2). Estimated export size 15GB, chunked into 8 files.
2026-03-12: Export job ran on serving-exporter pod export-12; export manifest draft created at /tmp/SUP-512938/manifest.json.
Hypotheses / checks performed:
- Confirmed no retention holds for the date range via retention-service (ok).
- Verified that audit events include 'request_id', 'timestamp', 'actor', 'endpoint', and 'model' fields; customer sample expects 'client_geo' which is present in 92% of events.
- Kernel: observed transient 5xxs during export job start attributed to a brief S3 credential rotation; re-ran exporter and succeeded.
External refs:
- Slack thread: #support (ts: 2026-03-11T09:12Z)
- Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Audit+Export+Runbook
- Related ticket SUP-720145 (on audit manifest format) contains previous manifest schema decisions.
resolution:
Workaround / temporary deliverable: Provided a sample signed manifest and HMAC proof for one chunk (sent 2026-03-12).
Final deliverable planned: 2026-03-13 at 16:00 UTC - full archive uploaded to s3://redwood-exports/nordicbank/SUP-512938/ with presigned URL valid 72h. Included artifacts: 8 JSONL chunk files (UTC ordered), manifest.json (with SHA-256 and per-file HMAC-SHA256), manifest.json.sig (ed25519 signature), manifest.rfc3161.tst (timestamp token), security_questionnaire_answers.xlsx, ecs_graylog_mapping.md, and delivery_receipt.txt.
Post-delivery actions:
- Confirm download and checksum match with customer (assigned to Support).
- Create a short audit note to legal for chain-of-custody (assigned to Security).
- Add an automated export template for enterprise customers to avoid manual steps (backlog ticket created).
